description: Sets up Stripe Tax on the developer's payout account (they are the seller; the taxes are theirs). "add_registration" / "expire_registration" set where tax is collected and change checkouts at once; registering with the tax authority is the developer's own legal step. "report": call with { from, to }, then with { runId } until a download link. "app" turns automatic tax on or off in one app's checkouts, at once. More: neblla_get_llms tools/tax

address.description: set_head_office: { country, postal_code, city, line1, state? }.

automatic.description: app: true charges tax in its checkouts.

inclusive.description: app: prices include the tax (default true) or it is added on top.

projectId.description: A project with its own Stripe: its taxes.

state.description: add_registration: the state, where there are any.

taxBehavior.description: set_defaults: whether prices include the tax.

taxCode.description: set_defaults: the product tax code, e.g. txcd_10000000 (digital goods).

name: neblla_tax
title: Set up taxes
